items.title: Marty Morell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Orlando, Florida, February 24, 2017
items.q: Yeah. That was a fun gig, Takana Miyamoto. And we went to Japan and it was actually on that tour that I met my wife.

ctx.x: That’s really nice. That must be an interesting experience for you, because you played with him and now you’re playing this —
Yeah. That was a fun gig, Takana Miyamoto. And we went to Japan and it was actually on that tour that I met my wife.
